arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) FROM service_config) AS configs, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',booking_id,'request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'reference',client_reference)) FROM bookings WHERE status <> 'confirmed') AS incomplete, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',charge_id,'booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step)) FROM charges WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status <> 'confirmed')) AS charges, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event',event_id,'request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events) AS cancellations, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox WHERE status <> 'delivered') AS outbox, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('flight',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights) AS flights, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache) AS cache

SELECT (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',booking_id,'request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'reference',client_reference)) FROM bookings WHERE status <> 'confirmed' OR client_reference IS NOT NULL) AS bookings, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',charge_id,'booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step)) FROM charges WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status <> 'confirmed' OR client_reference IS NOT NULL)) AS charges, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event',event_id,'request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events) AS cancellations, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox WHERE status <> 'delivered') AS outbox, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking',booking_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id)) FROM holds WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status <> 'confirmed')) AS holds, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) FROM service_config) AS configs, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step)) FROM fare_holds) AS fare_holds
